author: blu
body: Proves activated abilities: the firebreathing family. A creature whose Oracle text says "{R}: ~ gets +1/+0" compiles to an ActivatedAbility, and in combat its controller spends floating red mana to pump it, once per {R}. Firebreathing is repeatable, so all available mana is sunk into power: a 5/5 Shivan Dragon with three red floating attacks for 8. Remove the mana and it is a 5/5 again.
